title: Quality triage playbook notes (1:1 prep)
content:
Purpose: quick prep for 1:1 with Priya (optimize lead) — align on triage workflow for recent quality regression, decide immediate mitigations, and owners for short experiments.

Meeting slot: 2026-03-11 10:30am PT (30m) — keep focused: diagnostics + 3 action items max.
Attendees (expected): Priya, Omar, Noah (optional deep-dive), Rhea (SRE if we need rollout/unfreeze)

Topline snapshot (internal quick metrics):
- regression surfaced: +5.8% hallucination rate on knowledge-base task (KB-A) since model roll 2026-02-14
- user-impact: downstream precision drop from 92% -> 86% on sampled production queries (n=2.1k)
- latency/throughput unaffected (same model variant, no infra change)
- A/B test snapshot: control (v1.6) vs candidate (v1.7-quantized) — candidate shows higher leniency to assertive answers (more confident hallucinations)

Immediate hypothesis list (ranked rough):
1) Quantization profile changed logits distribution for rare-token sampling -> higher false-positives on KB facts
2) Prompt set used for rollout has slightly different system instruction (shortened safety guard by 6 words) -> less conservative responses
3) Dataset shift: production queries include more partial-URLs and entity fragments (edge-case not in eval dataset)
4) Temperature/autotuning misconfig on serving node for that customer tier (unlikely: infra check next)

Quick debug checklist (what I'll bring to meeting):
- small reproducible cases (3): query1, query2, query3 (copy/paste examples)
- token-level diffs for the three cases (v1.6 vs v1.7-quantized) — highlight where probability mass moved
- prompt diffs: canonical prompt used in canary rollout vs prod canonical (extract from route config)
- eval-run artifacts: last nightly eval id + metric deltas (ref: JIRA-OPT-542)
- GH PR: models/pull/128 notes on quant changes + test comments

Decision points for meeting (explicit asks):
A) Temporary rollback? If >4% precision drop on top-500 queries, we roll back candidate for that route. Need Priya sign-off.
B) Quick patch options (choose 1):
   - revert to previous quant profile (fast, infra safe)
   - inject stronger safety token bias in prompt (prod-side prompt update)
   - selective routing to CPU-backed variant for KB-heavy customers (costly)
C) Longer-term: run targeted evaluation with expanded KB-like prompts, and add prefix caching for stable facts.

Experiment proposals (30/60/90 minute cadence):
- Exp A (15m deploy): Quick prompt tweak — add single-line guard: "If uncertain, say 'I don't know' and ask for clarification." Monitor 
  Metrics: hallucination rate on sampled KB-A queries (15m/1h/4h). Owner: Omar -> deploy patch to canary 1 route.
- Exp B (45m deploy): Re-run quantization with per-layer clamp (tighter on output logits) from PR #128 (needs eng time). Owner: Noah -> perf/regression tests.
- Exp C (2 days): Expanded AB on top-5 KB customers with fallback routing. Owner: Priya to coordinate with sales/customer-success for opt-in.

Rollback criteria (explicit):
- If top-500 user queries show >4% drop in precision at any 1h window after candidate rollout -> immediate rollback to v1.6 and notify customers.
- If hallucinations escalate beyond 8% absolute on KB-A -> escalate to incident channel and involve SRE.

Action items (concrete)
- Omar: prepare token-diff snippets + deploy prompt patch to canary (Exp A) — due: 2026-03-11 EOD.
- Noah: run per-layer quant sanity checks and surface perf tradeoffs (Exp B) — due: 2026-03-13.
- Priya: sign-off criteria and coordinate canary cohort, contact product for customer opt-in (Exp C) — due: 2026-03-12.
- Rhea: verify autoscaling/fallback behavior for route in case of rollback (SRE checklist) — due: 2026-03-11.

Notes-to-self / talking bullets for 1:1:
- Start with data: show the 3 reproducible cases, then the metric delta, then proposed Exp A. Ask Priya: "Which is least risky from a customer-experience POV?"
- If pushback on prompt patch, emphasize guard is reversible and low-latency.
- Keep conversation outcome-oriented: aim to have a deploy decision in this sync.

Open questions / unknowns (to surface):
- Did any downstream preprocessor change between 02/10 and 02/14? (ask infra/product)
- Are there customers who saw this earlier but didn't report? (CS channel?)
- Is the nightly eval suite missing KB-like truncated entities? (we should add)

Follow-ups after meeting (template I'll use):
- Quick note to #optimize-sync: short summary + decisions + links to canary route + action owners (I'll send within 1h)
- Create a lightweight postmortem if rollback occurs (owner: Priya)

Slack / ticket references to include during meeting:
- Slack thread: #optimize-alerts (pinned message link placeholder)
- JIRA: JIRA-OPT-542 (regression triage)
- GH: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/128

Tone: keep it pragmatic, avoid overfitting to single examples. Aim to ship low-risk guard first, run diagnostic quant experiments in parallel.

Misc scribbles (do not present):
- consider adding a tiny calibrated confidence score in response metadata so clients can opt to hide low-confidence assertions (longer-term product ask).
- add a small eval set with intentionally truncated entities (KB-frag) to nightly.
- remember to cc customer-success if we do any rollback that might touch paying customers.

End of notes.
